title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-10-13
content:
Release Engineering - Meeting notes
Date: 2026-10-13
Attendees: Riley Patel (owner), Maya Thompson, Ethan Li, Sofia Rodriguez, Jordan Kim, Liam O'Connor
Location: Zoom / #releng
Duration: 45m

Purpose: Weekly sync for upcoming release train (v1.12.0), open hotfix (RELENG-482), canary rollout plan, and changelog items.

Agenda:
1) Release train status - v1.12.0 (scheduled 2026-10-20)
2) Hotfix RELENG-482 - RPC timeout causing production errors
3) Changelog highlights and release notes draft
4) Canary rollout plan and metrics to monitor
5) Blockers and action items

Notes:
1) Release train status - v1.12.0
- Branch cut planned for 2026-10-15 09:00 PT. Feature freeze 10/15 18:00 PT.
- Current candidate list: feature flags for batching improvements (RELENG-470), kernel-selection fallback (RELENG-475), telemetry opt-in for internal tests (RELENG-478).
- QA schedule: regression suite runs 10/16-10/18. Need additional coverage for long-sequence scenario (E2E).
- Docs: Release notes draft is in Confluence (linked). Maya to add user-facing notes for batching changes.
- Decision: Keep beta batching flag disabled by default; enable for Dedicated customers on opt-in.

2) Hotfix RELENG-482 (critical)
- Symptom: Sporadic RPC timeouts (~0.2% requests) when KV cache warm-up overlaps with heavy concurrent prefix loads.
- Root cause (investigation): Race in cache eviction path under high concurrency; exacerbated by new batching heuristics.
- Mitigation deployed (temporary): SRE rolled back batching heuristics on prod nodes in us-west-2 at 03:40 on 10/13 - reduced error spike.
- Fix: PR #987 includes mutex around eviction + added unit test and stress test scenario.
- Rollout plan: Patch release 1.11.3 (hotfix) to be cut 10/13 17:00 PT, small canary (5% nodes) for 2 hours, then expand to 40% if no regressions. Full rollout 10/14 morning.
- Monitoring: Error rate (5xx), latency p95, cache hit ratio, and RPC timeout count (RELENG-482 alert).
- Owners: Ethan Li (fix author), Jordan Kim (SRE rollout owner), Riley Patel (release approval).

3) Changelog & release notes
- High level bullets to include: batching heuristic improvements (opt-in), kernel-selection resilience changes, telemetry opt-in, security patch in protobuf dependency (non-user-facing).
- Breaking changes: None. Backwards-compatible behavior unchanged. Note to call out opt-in semantics for Dedicated.
- Draft link: Confluence page in linked_artifacts - Maya to produce first pass by EOD 10/14.

4) Canary rollout plan for v1.12.0
- Canary tiers: 5% (smoke), 25% (extended), 100% (full). Each stage gated on 2h stable window and automated checks.
- Automated checks: SLOs (p99 latency < 2s for text-gen baseline), error rate < 0.1% above baseline, CPU/GPU utilization, KV cache hit ratio not dropping >5% from baseline.
- Manual checkpoints: after 25% we will do a brief check-in with product (Maya) and SRE (Jordan).
- Fallback: automated rollback to previous model-serving binary + config (tag: v1.11.2) if error threshold breached.

5) Blockers / risks
- Test coverage gap: long-sequence regen tests flakey in CI - slows release gating. Action: Sofia to add stabilized test harness by 10/15.
- Third-party deps: tiny protobuf security patch requires rebuild for Dedicated images. Release-engineering needs to verify image build pipeline for private deployments (Liam).
- Capacity: Dedicated customers with pinned versions may see behavioral differences; coordinate with Customer Success for scheduled communication (Maya).

Decisions made:
- Hotfix 1.11.3 will be cut today (10/13) and canary rolled per plan.
- v1.12.0 feature batching remains opt-in; enable by default for internal experiments only.

Action items (owner - due):
- Ethan Li - finalize PR #987, add stress-test logs + merge subject to green CI - due 2026-10-13 16:30 PT.
- Jordan Kim - schedule canary rollout and prepare runbook for rollback; confirm SRE paging thresholds - due 2026-10-13 18:30 PT.
- Maya Thompson - first draft release notes/changelog for v1.12.0 and customer comms for Dedicated - due 2026-10-14 EOD.
- Sofia Rodriguez - stabilize long-sequence CI harness and add deterministic inputs - due 2026-10-15 12:00 PT.
- Liam O'Connor - validate Dedicated image rebuild pipeline with updated protobuf; produce quick checklist for private deploys - due 2026-10-15 EOD.
- Riley Patel - approve hotfix release after successful canary; coordinate with Legal on embargoed security note (if needed) - due 2026-10-13 20:00 PT.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want to proactively notify Dedicated customers about opt-in batching change or wait until GA? Action: Maya to recommend comms strategy by 10/14.
- Need final sign-off criteria for v1.12.0 from Product - add to release checklist.

Meeting adjourned. Next sync: 2026-10-15 (branch-cut day) 09:30 PT - short check-in for cut status and outstanding blockers.

Notes to self / informal:
- Keep hotfix branch isolated; don’t cherry-pick unrelated perf experiments.
- Keep an eye on telemetry spike around 03:30-04:00 UTC - might be recurring with regional traffic pattern.
- Add a follow-up item: postmortem template for cache-eviction race (owner: Ethan).

END
